questions.question: Analyse the contrast between Gaza and California in Letter from Gaza. What do these places symbolise for the narrator?
questions.solution_html:
• California is shown as a place of comfort, opportunity, and personal freedom. It represents a
  • peaceful, modern life where the narrator can pursue education and escape violence
  • Gaza-is portrayed as a space of destruction, loss, and constant struggle. The war-torn environment,
  • especially through Nadia’s suffering, symbolizes the harsh reality of Palestinian life. (An/CO2)
